send_intents.subject: Full Stack TypeScript Engineer application
send_intents.body:
Hi Stat Sniper team,

Your Full Stack TypeScript Engineer role combines Next.js App Router, a headless CMS, Postgres-backed sports data, and Core Web Vitals work. I like that the challenge is not just building pages: the content and data need to stay useful and fast during live games.

At Stride AI, I owned React interfaces and backend APIs, including a schema-driven Page Studio with preview and publishing flows. I've also shipped production features with CI and end-to-end tests. I'd enjoy owning the web experience and its data boundaries.

Could you consider my GitHub-based application for this role?

Devansh
Portfolio: https://devansh.aurat.ai
GitHub: https://github.com/8dazo
send_intents.eligibility_evidence: Employer explicitly says every role worldwide remote, candidates anywhere in world, no relocation
send_intents.email_evidence: Official role page says email careers@statsniper.com and resume or GitHub
send_intents.message_quality_angle: Specific sports-data/SEO/Core Web Vitals hook, Page Studio CMS and frontend proof; differs from prior 10 agent-centric outreach emails.

notes: Waiting for 08:00 IST before any Gmail send; no other outbound writer permitted.
